Capture baseline compile result and warning text

objectives.note: No commit made: transformation netted zero diff vs HEAD (HEAD already had these 39 sites restored). See deviations.

deviations.description: Commit: task 445 phase 1: bulk-restore 39 commented-out footnotes
deviations.reason: The bulk sed transformation of the 39 footnote sites produced zero diff against HEAD, because HEAD's committed content already had these 39 sites restored (no FIX: tags). The dirty working tree at task start had reintroduced the FIX-annotated form as part of unrelated, uncommitted WIP for sibling tasks 446/447 (commented-out proof/prose blocks under their 12 bare FIX: tags). Staging typst/FormalFoundations.typ for a phase-1 commit would have swept that unrelated foreign WIP into a task-445-attributed commit, violating targeted commit-scope rules. No phase-1 commit was made; the transformation is verified live via grep against the working file instead.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — phase-1 transformation netted zero diff vs HEAD ... no phase-1 commit was made because staging the file would sweep in unrelated uncommitted WIP from sibling tasks 446/447)*
